moves.name: Hydraulic Force Aqua Tail
moves.description:
Activation Condition: When the user uses any move once.
Deactivation Condition: Cannot be deactivated.

Never misses. Lowers the target’s Defense and Speed by 2 stat ranks. Applies the Physical Move Break effect to the target the first time this attack move is successful each battle.

moves.name: Unova Passion
moves.description: Increases the Physical Moves ↑ Next effect of all allied sync pairs by 1 rank. Applies Unova Circle (Physical) to the allied field of play. Unova Circle (Physical) grants all of the following effects: Powers up the physical attack moves and physical sync moves of all allied sync pairs by 10%. Reduces physical attack move and physical sync move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by 5%. The more sync pairs with the Unova theme that are on the allied field of play, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves and sync moves by 10% and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is 40%, and the maximum damage reduction is 14%.)

moves.name: Like a Fresh Stream!
moves.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by one. Raises the user’s Attack by 4 stat ranks. Raises the user’s critical-hit rate by 3 stat ranks.

moves.name: Flowing Blue Trouble Water Impact
moves.description: The more the user’s Speed is raised, the greater the power of this attack.

passives.name: The Purest Water
passives.description: Raises the Speed of all allied sync pairs by 2 stat ranks when an ally applies a circle to the allied field of play. Applies the Free Move Next effect to all allied sync pairs when an ally applies a circle to the allied field of play.

subPassives.name: Ally Sets Circle: Team Speed ↑2 9
subPassives.description: Has a chance (100%) of raising the Speed of all allied sync pairs by 2 stat ranks when an ally applies a circle to the allied field of play.

subPassives.name: Ally Sets Circle: Team Free Move Next 9
subPassives.description: Has a chance (100%) of applying the Free Move Next effect to all allied sync pairs when an ally applies a circle to the allied field of play.

passives.name: Use Unova Passion: Sync CD ↓ 9
passives.description: Has a chance (100%) of reducing the user’s sync move countdown by 1 when it uses Unova Passion.

passives.name: Circle: Team Condition Nullification
passives.description: Prevents all allied sync pairs from being inflicted with status conditions, flinching, becoming confused, or becoming trapped when a circle applies to the allied field of play.
